# Madgrowth

> Madgrowth helps leaders in tech with 5 to 10+ years of experience turn that experience into a business they own: a fractional role, a services or advisory business, or software. It's run by Madalena Rugeroni: ex-Google, advisor and investor, who scaled startups from zero to $10M in revenue and runs a portfolio of internet businesses, including the software company Mazo. Madalena also advises startup founders from 0 to $1M in revenue on go-to-market.

Experienced operators usually have the credibility to go independent. Where they get stuck is the offer: what to sell, who buys it, how to package it and what to charge. Madgrowth works on exactly that, either self-serve with AI agents that run in Claude or 1:1 with Madalena. Prices are in euros.

## Offers for leaders in tech

- [The Builder Diagnostic](https://www.madgrowth.io/diagnostic/): Free, about 3 minutes. Short scenarios that identify your Builder Archetype (Broadcaster, Advisor, Productizer, Venture Builder or Orchestrator) and which business models fit how you work. Includes the free Expertise Audit by email, which finds your three strongest angles from your career.
- [The Stack](https://www.madgrowth.io/stack/): 299€ one-time. Fifteen AI agents that run in Claude (installed as Claude skills) and work as one system. A setup step classifies your business (services, software, product, local, media, marketplaces), then each agent uses the version for that model and ends with a document: go/no-go, customer interviews, ICP, positioning, messaging, offer, pricing, unit economics, founder content, lead magnet, landing page, launch plan, customer acquisition, conversion and retention. Agents draw on April Dunford, Blair Enns, Alex Hormozi, Bob Moesta, Madhavan Ramanujam, David C. Baker and others.
- [The Read](https://www.madgrowth.io/#audit): 599€ one-time. A written diagnosis, delivered within 5 business days of confirming the intake, that reviews where you are on the five steps (decide, position, package, audience, launch), with a 90-day roadmap and a direct verdict. Credited toward The Build within 14 days.
- [The Build](https://www.madgrowth.io/#build): 1,200€ a month, 3-month minimum. 1:1 with Madalena to position, package, price and launch in 90 days. Two 60-minute sessions a month, unlimited chat between sessions, reviews of your positioning, offer page, site and launch plan, and The Stack included. Limited to 10 active clients.

## Offer for startup founders

- [Startup Go-to-Market Advisory](https://www.madgrowth.io/startups/): a go-to-market advisor for founders and an alternative to hiring a fractional CMO. 3,000€ a month, 3-month minimum. For founders from 0 to $1M in revenue, any kind of startup. Up to four sessions a month plus unlimited chat, covering positioning, pricing, ICP, demand and a repeatable path to revenue. Mazo is included for B2B SaaS companies. Five founders at a time. Starts with a free 15-minute call.

## Newsletter

- [From operator to owner](https://www.madgrowth.io/newsletter/): Madalena's free weekly newsletter for leaders in tech who want income beyond their job. Experiments, numbers and mistakes from building businesses. 3-minute read, every Thursday.

- [How I ended up on a call with Greg Isenberg, and what he told me to change](https://www.madgrowth.io/newsletter/on-a-call-with-greg-isenberg/): Greg Isenberg reviewed Madgrowth and Mazo: bundle software with advisory, give visitors a smaller first step than a call, and price in USD. What I changed.
- [Testing a business idea used to cost €50K. Now it costs €50 and an afternoon.](https://www.madgrowth.io/newsletter/what-used-to-cost-50k-now-costs-50/): The cost of building has collapsed; validation and distribution are the hard part now. Why the builder-distributor is the most valuable person in tech, and what I'm teaching at Nova SBE.
- [The best investment I ever made wasn't in a brokerage account](https://www.madgrowth.io/newsletter/money-questions-i-dont-usually-answer/): Recording a podcast about money for Santander made me say out loud what I'd been avoiding: expertise compounds like capital, and I priced mine like it didn't matter for years.
- [I can't code. I built a SaaS anyway (in a weekend, with Claude Code).](https://www.madgrowth.io/newsletter/i-cant-code-i-built-a-saas-anyway/): How I vibe-coded Mazo, an AI go-to-market advisor for B2B SaaS founders, with zero development background: why, what went into it, and what happened when I posted it.
- [You have a track record nobody knows about. Waiting is the decision.](https://www.madgrowth.io/newsletter/a-track-record-nobody-knows-about/): A senior PM with 15 years in tech, a niche and real results told me he can't build in public because his employer would see. Why waiting is itself a decision, and how to start quietly.
- [Someone asked me how to get passive income. Here's the honest answer.](https://www.madgrowth.io/newsletter/how-to-get-passive-income/): Three friends in a group chat asked for a podcast on getting rich. What I told them: zero-employee businesses cost under $500 to start, trust is the real asset, and action comes before expertise.
- [How I ended up here: from Google to Too Good To Go to a portfolio of my own businesses](https://www.madgrowth.io/newsletter/how-i-ended-up-here/): Madalena Rugeroni's story: chasing a job at Google, a failed startup, running Too Good To Go in three countries, a wrong turn into crypto, Head of Growth at a B2B SaaS, and the decision to build a portfolio of businesses instead.
- [The Offer Ladder: the five-tier business model I wish I'd known earlier](https://www.madgrowth.io/newsletter/the-offer-ladder/): A five-tier system for building a product suite one layer at a time: lead magnet, micro-offer, core product, high-touch offer, continuity. Which two tiers to start with and why.
- [From one income stream to five: what happened when I started building in public](https://www.madgrowth.io/newsletter/from-one-to-multiple-revenue-streams/): Relying on one income makes you fragile. How showing up consistently on LinkedIn turned into a digital product, paid advisory, a newsletter, speaking and company programs, and the stack-don't-wait playbook.
- [The four-part playbook I use to build lean, profitable businesses without funding](https://www.madgrowth.io/newsletter/the-playbook-for-two-profitable-businesses/): From a hotel in Mexico: the playbook behind Favorite People and Madgrowth. Pick a niche you understand, use low-code tools, capture intent not attention, and build a brand, not just a product.
- [€3.5K in 30 days from a digital product: what actually worked](https://www.madgrowth.io/newsletter/3-5k-in-30-days-what-worked/): A 30-day test: build an income stream without a team, ads or a big audience. Under €300 spent, a 71% newsletter open rate, daily posting, and five things that made it work.
- [Build income that doesn't need you first, then the business you love](https://www.madgrowth.io/newsletter/before-you-start-your-business-read-this/): Favorite People is profitable, growing 230% year over year, and still not passive. Why I'd build a scalable income stream before a business that needs you daily, and what that changes.

## Who it's for

- Directors, VPs, heads of growth, product and engineering leaders, and consultants with 5 to 10+ years in tech who want more autonomy and something of their own.
- People still employed, recently independent, or already building a product.
- Not a course, not a job marketplace and not a community.

## Builder Archetypes

The Builder Diagnostic sorts people into five Builder Archetypes, a framework created by Madalena Rugeroni. Each archetype is a position on five dimensions (Engine, Bet, Tempo, Moat, Buyers) and points to the businesses that fit.

- [The five Builder Archetypes](https://www.madgrowth.io/archetypes/): overview, comparison table and the five dimensions.
- [The Broadcaster](https://www.madgrowth.io/archetypes/broadcaster/): creator-led businesses where your voice is the distribution.
- [The Advisor](https://www.madgrowth.io/archetypes/advisor/): fractional leadership, high-ticket consulting and advisory retainers.
- [The Productizer](https://www.madgrowth.io/archetypes/productizer/): toolkits, templates, self-serve courses and productized services.
- [The Venture Builder](https://www.madgrowth.io/archetypes/venture-builder/): SaaS, micro-SaaS and AI tools.
- [The Orchestrator](https://www.madgrowth.io/archetypes/orchestrator/): boutique agencies, AI-assisted service delivery and done-for-you offers.

## Guides

- [What to sell after leaving a tech job](https://www.madgrowth.io/guides/what-to-sell-after-tech/): Sell an outcome you've delivered more than once to a buyer who already pays for it. How to find your angle after a tech job, test it and avoid the traps.
- [How to become a fractional executive](https://www.madgrowth.io/guides/how-to-go-fractional/): Become a fractional executive by packaging one problem you've solved as a monthly role with set days and outcomes, then selling it to your network first.
- [How to price fractional and consulting services](https://www.madgrowth.io/guides/how-to-price-fractional-consulting/): Price fractional services from the cost of the problem and the hire it replaces. Day rate vs retainer vs value pricing, with European day rates in euros.
- [Fractional, consulting or software: which business should you start after tech?](https://www.madgrowth.io/guides/fractional-consulting-or-software/): Fractional and consulting work pay within weeks; software pays later but grows past your hours. How ex tech leaders choose, with a side-by-side comparison.
- [How to build a micro SaaS from your tech career](https://www.madgrowth.io/guides/how-to-build-a-micro-saas/): Build a micro SaaS from a workflow you know: validate with pre-sales, price it for B2B and win your first 10 customers. Ideas, AI MVPs and real timelines.
- [How to build an audience business from your expertise](https://www.madgrowth.io/guides/how-to-build-an-audience-business/): Build an audience business: pick a narrow beat from your career, one platform and a weekly cadence, then sell services or products before subscriptions.
- [How to start an agency after a career in tech](https://www.madgrowth.io/guides/how-to-start-an-agency/): To start an agency, pick one client type and outcome, sell a productized offer first, price for margin and hand delivery to a small senior team and systems.
- [How to sell digital products from your expertise](https://www.madgrowth.io/guides/how-to-sell-digital-products/): Sell digital products by choosing a format your buyer already pays for, pre-selling it, then doing the distribution. Formats, pricing and platforms compared.

- [Fractional executive rates in 2026: day rates and retainers by role](https://www.madgrowth.io/guides/fractional-executive-rates/): Fractional CMO, CTO, CPO and COO rates for 2026: day rates, monthly retainers and hourly bands in the US, UK and Europe, with the method I use to set a rate from the seller's side.
- [How to start fractional or consulting work while still employed](https://www.madgrowth.io/guides/fractional-while-employed/): Start fractional or consulting work while employed: what to check in your contract (non-compete, moonlighting, IP), a time model that fits around a job, how to tell your employer, and how to land the first client quietly.
- [Laid off from tech: take the next job, go fractional, or build something?](https://www.madgrowth.io/guides/what-to-do-after-tech-layoff/): A decision guide for the weeks after a tech layoff: how much runway you have, whether to take the next job, go fractional, or build a product, and how to use severance as seed money without wasting it.

- [How to create a Claude skill](https://www.madgrowth.io/guides/how-to-create-a-claude-skill/): folder structure, a working SKILL.md example, how to write descriptions Claude triggers on, and how to install and test a skill.
